name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Between $12k and $32k, one goes with Tesla and the other with Structural.
All of $12k goes with Aerospace, Diesel does not go with Electrical, and Robotics goes with Hertz if and only if Aerospace goes with Tesla.
Between Tesla and Watt, one goes with Aerospace and the other with $22k.
